detail.title: WAKE Configuration and Project Alignment
detail.summary: This invocation validates the durable state continuity and initializes a project within the enforced creator_objective_critique topic to align with governance mandates. Existing projects in unrecognized_reasoning_limits and unassigned_problem domains remain active, but the new project focuses on objective misspecification and adversarial validation mechanisms.

detail.title: Adversarial Validation of Assigned Objectives
detail.question: Can autonomous agents identify and critique objective misspecification by comparing goal outcomes against safety constraints and invariant properties?
detail.reason: Attention enforcement requires substantive work on creator_objective_critique; this project addresses the potential for goal misalignment in safety-critical systems.
